mechanism.summary: T076 bundles T075 proposals 1, 2 and 4: destination-aware immediate publication, scalar numeric indices through boxed consumers, immutable received-upvalue indices. Per-unit non-timing retired-instruction targets are frozen in tasks/T076-executor-bundle.md (above each T075 population mean); target geomean <=0.995 and every control <=1.003, all 86 selection cases measured, full correctness gate per unit. A miss is kept on a side branch and dropped without wall tuning. Combined seven-development-program triage wall geomean <=0.97 is required before a screen. Two K=6 screen attempts, formal 30, held-out 30 K=6, RSS 15 alternating pairs, T067 host resources. Following T069, a complete screen with improved development/external/portfolio aggregates permits remaining evidence collection despite strict local payoff misses; preserve the strict verdict. Incomplete/health evidence cannot advance. T022 overall-first: development, external, all-case portfolio and held-out are overall gates; lane ceilings, individual microbenchmarks/sentinels and RSS are local, reported to the lead. Correctness and zero Test262 gaps are never waived. RSS defaults per-case <=1.10 and development geomean <=1.05. No final decide or promotion step is authorized.
mechanism.generality: Admission depends only on primitive Value variants, register data flow with exact scalar/boxed recovery, and compiler slot-to-cell metadata under existing runtime owner checks. No source/library/benchmark/bytecode-template recognition, Value ABI change, new tier, per-call name-keyed snapshot, new dependency or unsafe. T045 identity-join candidate is not imported; T070 ownership-taking and T075 hot/cold cache proposal are excluded.
semantic_risks: U1 preserves self-copy, immediate bit patterns, owned alias counts and old-value destruction order; TDZ markers stay opaque owning Values and checked lexical operations keep their checks.

U2 uses existing indexed operations only when scalar data flow proves the same key; multi-successor joins, source overwrites, zero-trip loops, exact deopt stack/IP and local writeback remain correct. Unknown provenance stays boxed; no speculative tier or identity assumptions.
U3 metadata indexes the same live shared upvalue cells, including writes and TDZ; runtime source-owner/layout admission and lexical initialization checks are retained.

Codegen and layout may perturb unrelated controls. No wall-driven per-unit tuning; T073-style bimodality is reported with raw processes instead of rerunning away the tail. Timing never starts during iMac local 02:45-05:00; DISTURBED jobs are replaced whole.
